```{r}
# Replace 'path/to/your/spaceranger/output/directory' with the actual path
bin_dir <- "/home/mattia/Thesis/111125ST_def/segmented_data/binned_outputs/square_008um"

# Load as a standard Spatial Seurat object
# NOTE: For Visium HD, if you specify bin.size, Load10X_Spatial expects data.dir 
# to be the folder ABOVE "square_XXXum" (the binned_outputs folder).
parent_dir <- dirname(bin_dir) 
print(paste("Checking directory levels..."))
print(paste("Parent directory (binned_outputs):", parent_dir))

all_files <- list.files(bin_dir)
h5_files <- all_files[grepl("\\.h5$", all_files)]
print(paste("H5 files found in Resolution folder:", paste(h5_files, collapse=", ")))

visium_8um <- tryCatch({
  # Explicitly pick the first h5 if multiple exist, ensuring it's length 1
  selected_h5 <- h5_files[1]
  if ("filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5" %in% h5_files) {
      selected_h5 <- "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
  }
  
  if (is.na(selected_h5)) stop("No .h5 files found in resolution folder")
  
  # APPROACH 1: Attempt standard Visium HD loading from the PARENT folder
  Load10X_Spatial(
    data.dir = parent_dir,
    bin.size = 8,
    assay = "Spatial.008um"
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  print(paste("Approach 1 failed:", e$message))
  print("Attempting Approach 2: Direct loading from Resolution folder...")
  
  # APPROACH 2: If Approach 1 fails, try loading directly from the specific square folder
  tryCatch({
      Load10X_Spatial(
        data.dir = bin_dir,
        filename = as.character(h5_files[1]), 
        assay = "Spatial.008um"
      )
  }, error = function(e2) {
      print(paste("Approach 2 failed:", e2$message))
      print("Final Fallback: Manual Object Construction...")
      h5_path <- file.path(bin_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
      if(!file.exists(h5_path)) h5_path <- file.path(bin_dir, h5_files[1])
      counts <- Read10X_h5(h5_path)
      CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, assay = "Spatial.008um")
  })
})
```

```{r}
# 1. Load the count matrix first to get the correct barcode format
counts <- Read10X_h5("/home/mattia/Thesis/111125ST_def/segmented_data/segmented_outputs/filtered_feature_cell_matrix.h5")
visium_seg <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, assay = "Segmented")

# 2. Prepare the GeoJSON data
geo_data <- st_read("/home/mattia/Thesis/111125ST_def/segmented_data/segmented_outputs/cell_segmentations.geojson")

# 3. Format the IDs to match "cellid_000000001-1"
# Ensure we pad correctly to match the 10x expression matrix barcodes
formatted_ids <- sprintf("cellid_%09d-1", as.numeric(geo_data$cell_id))
# We use make.unique because split polygons in GeoJSON can have duplicate IDs
rownames(geo_data) <- make.unique(formatted_ids)
geo_data$cell_id    <- formatted_ids

# 4. Geometry Cleaning (CRITICAL for CreateFOV)
# A. Repair and ensure validity
geo_data <- st_make_valid(geo_data)

# B. Extract Polygons and cast to POLYGON
# This ensures we have a clean sfc_POLYGON class
geo_data <- st_collection_extract(geo_data, "POLYGON")
geo_data <- st_cast(geo_data, "POLYGON", warn = FALSE)

# C. Reset Barcodes (CRITICAL)
# After st_cast, some features might have been split (e.g., cell_1 becomes cell_1.1)
# We must ensure the 'cell_id' column still contains the original barcode for matching.
# We also add a column named 'barcodes' which Seurat specifically looks for.
geo_data$barcodes <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", rownames(geo_data))
geo_data$cells    <- geo_data$barcodes

# D. Filter to keep only cells present in the Expression Matrix
valid_cells <- Cells(visium_seg)
geo_data <- geo_data[geo_data$barcodes %in% valid_cells, ]

# E. Remove any empty geometries 
geo_data <- geo_data[!st_is_empty(geo_data), ]

# --- VALIDATION CHECK 1: Overlay Integrity ---
cat("\n=== FOV Integrity Check ===\n")
cat("Geometry Class:", class(st_geometry(geo_data))[1], "\n")
cat("Cells in Matrix:", length(valid_cells), "\n")
cat("Features in sf object:", nrow(geo_data), "\n")
cat("Unique Barcodes in sf:", length(unique(geo_data$barcodes)), "\n")

overlap <- intersect(valid_cells, geo_data$barcodes)
cat("Overlap with Matrix:", length(overlap), "\n")

if (length(overlap) == 0) {
  stop("FATAL: Zero overlap between barcodes! Check rowname formatting.")
}

# 5. Create the FOV
# Subset the Seurat object to match the spatial data
visium_seg <- subset(visium_seg, cells = overlap)

# Create the FOV
# Adding the 'barcodes' column directly to the sf object ensures 
# Seurat's vertex extractor can map points back to cell IDs.
fov <- CreateFOV(
  coords = geo_data, 
  type = "segmentation",
  assay = "Segmented",
  key = "seg_"
)

# 6. Add to object
visium_seg[["fov"]] <- fov
```

```{r segmentation_qc_mapping}
# --- Quality Control Mapping ---
# 1. Calculate % Mitochondrial and % Ribosomal reads
# Note: Drosophila mitochondrial genes start with 'mt:' and ribosomal with 'Rp'
visium_seg[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(visium_seg, pattern = "^mt:")
visium_seg[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(visium_seg, pattern = "^Rp[LS]")

# 2. Identify low UMI cells (< 200 counts)
# We use a factor for discrete mapping in ImageDimPlot
visium_seg$QC_Status <- ifelse(visium_seg$nCount_Segmented < 200, "Low_UMI (<200)", "Pass")
visium_seg$QC_Status <- factor(visium_seg$QC_Status, levels = c("Pass", "Low_UMI (<200)"))

# 3. Generate Spatial Plots
p_qc_mito <- ImageFeaturePlot(
  object = visium_seg,
  features = "percent.mt",
  fov = "fov",
  cols = c("gray90", "darkred"),
  border.color = NA,
  border.size = 0,
  max.cutoff = "q95"
) + ggtitle("% Mitochondrial Reads")

p_qc_ribo <- ImageFeaturePlot(
  object = visium_seg,
  features = "percent.ribo",
  fov = "fov",
  cols = c("gray90", "darkblue"),
  border.color = NA,
  border.size = 0,
  max.cutoff = "q95"
) + ggtitle("% Ribosomal Reads")

# Highlight cells with low counts using group.by
p_qc_umi <- ImageDimPlot(
  object = visium_seg,
  fov = "fov",
  group.by = "QC_Status",
  cols = c("Pass" = "gray90", "Low_UMI (<200)" = "red"),
  size = 1,
  border.color = NA,
  border.size = 0
) + ggtitle("QC: Low UMI Detection")

# View side-by-side
(p_qc_mito | p_qc_ribo | p_qc_umi)

# Save QC maps
ggsave("../figures/segmentation_qc_mapping.png", plot = (p_qc_mito | p_qc_ribo | p_qc_umi), width = 18, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# --- 8. Robust Coordinate Assignment ---
# We calculate centroids to ensure every cell has a valid X/Y for downstream analysis.

# 1. Disable S2 Geometry (CRITICAL FIX)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# --- VALIDATION CHECK 2: Geometry Validity Logging ---
invalid_before <- !st_is_valid(geo_data)
num_invalid <- sum(invalid_before)

if (num_invalid > 0) {
  cat("\n=== Geometry Validation Warning ===\n")
  cat("Found", num_invalid, "cells with invalid geometries (self-intersections, holes, etc.)\n")
  cat("These will be auto-corrected using st_make_valid()\n")
  
  # Log which cells were invalid
  invalid_cells_log <- data.frame(
    cell_id = geo_data$cell_id[invalid_before],
    issue = "Invalid geometry corrected"
  )
  write.csv(invalid_cells_log, "../Excels/invalid_geometries_log.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Logged invalid cells to: invalid_geometries_log.csv\n")
} else {
  cat("\n=== Geometry Validation: All cells have valid geometries ===\n")
}

geo_fixed <- st_make_valid(geo_data)
centroids_sf <- st_centroid(geo_fixed)
coords_temp <- st_coordinates(centroids_sf)

# 3. Create Metadata Dataframe (Aggregated by Barcode)
# This handles cases where a cell was split into multiple polygons
coords_raw <- data.frame(
  barcode = geo_data$barcodes,
  x = coords_temp[, 1],
  y = coords_temp[, 2]
)

# Aggregate to get one coordinate pair per unique barcode
coords_aggregated <- coords_raw %>%
  group_by(barcode) %>%
  summarize(x_centroid = mean(x), y_centroid = mean(y)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Final coordinate dataframe for Seurat metadata
coords_df <- data.frame(
  x_centroid = coords_aggregated$x_centroid,
  y_centroid = coords_aggregated$y_centroid,
  row.names  = coords_aggregated$barcode
)

# Ensure the rows are in the same order as the Seurat object
coords_df <- coords_df[Cells(visium_seg), ]

# 4. Add to Seurat Object
visium_seg <- AddMetaData(visium_seg, metadata = coords_df)

print("Centroids calculated and added to metadata (x_centroid, y_centroid).")
head(visium_seg@meta.data[, c("x_centroid", "y_centroid")])

# Verify count
print(paste("Total Cells with Coordinates:", nrow(coords_df)))
```

```{r}
# --- 9. Alignment Verification ---
# We verify if the segmentation mask aligns with the tissue structure.
message("--- Alignment Verification ---")

fov_bbox <- st_bbox(geo_fixed)
print("Bounding Box of Segmentation Mask:")
print(fov_bbox)

# 2. Visual Check: Density of Segments
p_verify <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = geo_fixed, fill = "gray", color = NA) +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle("Verification: Segmentation Mask Geometry")

# Save this plot to visually inspect alignment
ggsave("../figures/verification_mask_geometry.png", plot = p_verify, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)

message("Saved 'verification_mask_geometry.png'. Please inspect this image.")

# --- 10. Side-Object: Cell Type Label Transfer ---
# We create a side object to verify identity without altering visium_seg for 3D_UMAP.
message("--- Side-Analysis: Label Transfer ---")

ref_path <- "/home/mattia/Thesis/Single-cell/seurat_ctrl_with_metadata.rds"

if (file.exists(ref_path)) {
  # 1. Create temporary side object
  visium_seg_transfer <- visium_seg 
  
  # 2. Load Single-Cell Reference
  sc_ref <- readRDS(ref_path)
  if (!"SCT" %in% names(sc_ref@assays)) sc_ref <- SCTransform(sc_ref, verbose = FALSE)
  
  # 3. Prepare Transfer Object (isolated)
  visium_seg_transfer <- SCTransform(visium_seg_transfer, assay = "Segmented", verbose = FALSE)
  visium_seg_transfer <- RunPCA(visium_seg_transfer, verbose = FALSE)

  # 4. Transfer Labels
  anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = sc_ref, query = visium_seg_transfer, 
                                normalization.method = "SCT", reference.assay = "SCT", 
                                query.assay = "SCT", dims = 1:20)

  predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, refdata = sc_ref@meta.data[["celltype"]],
                             prediction.assay = TRUE, weight.reduction = visium_seg_transfer[["pca"]], 
                             dims = 1:20)
  
  # Extract and filter (threshold 0.5)
  pred_scores <- predictions@data
  if("max" %in% rownames(pred_scores)) pred_scores <- pred_scores[rownames(pred_scores) != "max", ]
  max_scores <- apply(pred_scores, 2, max)
  predicted_ids <- rownames(pred_scores)[apply(pred_scores, 2, which.max)]
  predicted_ids[max_scores < 0.1] <- "Ambiguous"
  
  visium_seg_transfer$Predicted_CellType <- predicted_ids
  
  # 5. Spatial Plot (No Boundaries)
  p_transfer <- ImageDimPlot(visium_seg_transfer, fov = "fov", group.by = "Predicted_CellType",
                            cols = "polychrome", border.color = NA, border.size = 0) + 
                ggtitle("Side Analysis: Label Transfer")
  
  ggsave("../figures/verification_transfer_noborder.png", plot = p_transfer, width = 10, height = 8)
  message("Saved side-analysis transfer plot to ../figures/verification_transfer_noborder.png")
}
```

```{r side_literature_labeling}
# --- 11. Side-Object: Literature Identity ---
# Independent verification using canonical markers.
message("--- Side-Analysis: Literature Labeling (Enhanced) ---")

# 1. Create temporary side object
visium_seg_lit <- visium_seg 

# 2. Define Markers (Refined for Specificity - avoiding shared progenitors)
# Note: 'esg' is removed as it marks both ISC and EB. We rely on Dl/Su(H) distinction.
lit_markers <- list(
  # Progenitors (Split)
  ISC     = c("Dl", "spdo", "h", "kgo", "sna", "Delta"), # Notch Ligand High
  EB      = c("Su(H)", "klu", "N", "E(spl)m3-HLH", "E(spl)malpha-BFM", "da"), # Notch Target High
  
  # Enteroendocrine (Pan & Specific)
  EE      = c("pros", "AstA", "Tk", "NPF", "CCHa1", "Dh31", "Orcokinin", "allatostatin", "burs"),

  # Differentiating
  dEC     = c("zfh2", "Ote", "Sox100B", "boul", "Piezo", "Myo31DF"),

  # Specialized Regions
  Copper  = c("lab", "vha100-2", "vha55", "Cut", "Emp", "CAH1", "MtnA"),
  LFC     = c("PGRP-SC1a", "PGRP-SC1b", "Mvl", "Fer1HCH", "Fer2LCH", "Zip99C"),

  # Regional Enterocytes
  aEC     = c("Amy-p", "Amy-d", "bgs", "Pura", "Mylk", "jbug", "GATAe"),
  mEC     = c("dve", "Ptx1", "CREG", "apt", "alphaTry", "betaTry", "gammaTry"),
  pEC     = c("Cad99C", "LManVI", "LManV", "Gs2", "Gdh", "p38b", "bab1")
)

# 3. Enhanced Scoring & Noise Filtering
message("Calculating Module Scores...")
score_matrix <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(visium_seg_lit))

for (type in names(lit_markers)) {
  # Add score
  # We use tryCatch to handle cases where genes might be missing
  tryCatch({
    present <- lit_markers[[type]][lit_markers[[type]] %in% rownames(visium_seg_lit)]
    if(length(present) > 0) {
      visium_seg_lit <- AddModuleScore(visium_seg_lit, features = list(present), 
                                      name = paste0("Raw_", type), assay = "Segmented")
      
      # Extract the newly added column (Seurat appends '1' to name)
      col_name <- paste0("Raw_", type, "1")
      score_matrix[[type]] <- visium_seg_lit[[col_name]][,1]
    } else {
      score_matrix[[type]] <- 0 # If no markers found, score is 0
    }
  }, error = function(e) { message(paste("Error in", type, ":", e$message)) })
}

# 4. Strategy: "Exhalt" Differences (Z-Score + Thresholding)
message("Applying Signal Enhancement (Z-Score + Noise Floor)...")

# A. Z-Score Standardization per cell type (Column-wise)
# This highlights which cells are *significantly* high for that type compared to the population
score_scaled <- scale(score_matrix) 

# B. Hard Noise Floor
# If a cell's score is below the population mean (Z < 0), treat it as noise (0)
score_scaled[score_scaled < 0] <- 0

# C. Assign Identity
# Find max score per cell
max_scores <- apply(score_scaled, 1, max, na.rm=TRUE)
max_idx    <- apply(score_scaled, 1, which.max)
assigned_types <- colnames(score_scaled)[max_idx]

# D. Confidence Filter
# If the max Z-score is still very low (weak signal), mark as Unresolved.
# Threshold 0.5 means "at least 0.5 std devs above mean"
assigned_types[max_scores < 0.5] <- "Unresolved"

visium_seg_lit$Literature_Identity <- assigned_types

# 5. Spatial Plot (No Boundaries, Cleaner Colors)
p_lit <- ImageDimPlot(visium_seg_lit, fov = "fov", group.by = "Literature_Identity",
                     cols = "polychrome", border.color = NA, border.size = 0) + 
         ggtitle("Side Analysis: Enhanced Literature Labels")

ggsave("../figures/verification_literature_noborder.png", plot = p_lit, width = 10, height = 8)
message("Saved enhanced literature plot to ../figures/verification_literature_noborder.png")

# --- FINAL CONSOLIDATION FOR SHINY APP ---
# Merge metadata from side objects back into the main visium_seg object
visium_seg$Predicted_CellType <- visium_seg_transfer$Predicted_CellType

# Update the list and save complete data
vhd_list$seg <- visium_seg
saveRDS(vhd_list, file = "../Random data/VisiumHD_Drosophila_Resolution_List.rds")
message("✓ Final labeled object saved to ../Random data/VisiumHD_Drosophila_Resolution_List.rds")

```
